question: Which of the following ministers conducted surprise raids on seed and fertiliser godowns in Rajasthan in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kirori Lal Meena**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kirori Lal Meena**, a prominent political leader and minister in Rajasthan, conducted surprise raids on seed and fertiliser godowns in **June 2025**.
 
• The action was taken to ensure **availability of quality seeds and fertilisers** to farmers and to curb malpractices such as hoarding and black marketing.
 
• These surprise raids were conducted across various districts in Rajasthan where complaints regarding **adulterated seeds and fertilisers** had surfaced.
 
• Kirori Lal Meena, known for his proactive approach, aimed at addressing the grievances of farmers and ensuring transparency in agricultural supply chains.
 
• This initiative was part of broader efforts by the Rajasthan government to bolster agricultural productivity and maintain the integrity of farming inputs.
